messages:
Lin Zhao: hey everyone! Lin here — started today as SRE on infra. Remote first day but popping in later today — desk SF-5B if anyone wants to wave. small fun fact: I bake sourdough terribly well and tell worse puns. quick Q: coffee or tea? also any must-try lunch spots near Market St? :wave:
Harry Cole: welcome Lin!! :tada: coffee person here. Lunch recs: Bao Palace and Little Gem are safe bets. I can show you where the power towers are later.
Marta Ruiz: tea for me. also if there's a sourdough club sign me up :bread:. we do a short walk to the Embarcadero at 12:30 sometimes.
Devon Park: hey Lin — welcome to Redwood Inference. I’m on eng-ops, can help with badge/printer and desk setup. SF-5B rule: do not feed the ficus. :wink:
Amanda (People Ops): welcome aboard! I sent your onboarding checklist and swag survey — DM me your tee size. we have a welcome lunch plan on Friday if you want to join. :gift:
welcome-bot: Welcome to Redwood Inference, Lin Zhao! You were added to #new-hires and orientation events were added to your calendar. If you need anything urgent, ping @people-ops. :robot_face:
Lin Zhao: thanks all! coffee it is then. I’ll bring sourdough for Friday lunch if that’s cool — no obligation to eat my experiments. also where’s the best place to plug in an extra monitor? power strips by benches?
Harry Cole: yup power towers by the east benches and near the kitchen island. if you can’t find them ping me and I’ll come over. and I’ll bring a butter knife for the sourdough :yum:
Marta Ruiz: quick poll idea — react to this thread with :coffee: for coffee, :tea: for tea, :soda: for soda, or :sparkles: for other. welcome again, Lin!
